subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio as a first-class read-tool and LLM content type, or keep `read()` text/image-only and route audio through transcription/media-understanding workflows?
rationale: The requested behavior is not just an extension whitelist; it changes provider payload shape, local-file egress, model capability routing, unsupported-model errors, and transcript/session representation.

options.title: Design shared native-audio contract first
options.body: Add audio only after maintainers settle the typed content block, provider serialization, payload/security limits, session persistence, and fallback behavior, then implement the read-tool path on that contract.

options.title: Fold into the broader native-audio tracker
options.body: Keep this issue linked to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51667 and require that broader design to explicitly cover local `read()` audio-file parity before this can close.

options.title: Keep read text/image-only
options.body: Document audio as a media-understanding or transcription workflow and close this request as outside the current read-tool contract.

recommendation.title: Design shared native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Add audio only after maintainers settle the typed content block, provider serialization, payload/security limits, session persistence, and fallback behavior, then implement the read-tool path on that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent path history spans the read tool, LLM core, and media-core contracts that would need the product-direction decision.
